quizzes.title: Module 1 Quiz: Starting Out as a Social Media VA

questions.text: What does a Social Media Management VA primarily do?
choices: Plans, creates, schedules, and monitors a business's social content

questions.text: Why do most small business owners hire a Social Media VA?
choices: They lack the time or platform know-how to post consistently
It is cheaper than hiring no one
Social media accounts require a license

questions.text: Which trait do clients value most in a Social Media VA?
choices: Posting anything at any time without a plan
Reliability and matching the brand's voice

questions.text: Before creating content, why is it important to understand a client's brand voice?
choices: So every post sounds consistent with how the business talks to its audience
Because clients prefer generic, unbranded posts
It only matters for large corporations

questions.text: What is a key part of setting up a productive home workspace for social media work?
choices: A reliable internet connection and a distraction-free area
Working only from a phone with no backup plan
Sharing your client login with friends

questions.text: What is the main purpose of a content scheduling tool like Meta Business Suite or Later?
choices: To queue up posts in advance so they publish automatically

questions.text: What is Canva primarily used for in this role?
choices: Designing graphics and social media visuals

questions.text: What can Meta Business Suite manage together?
choices: Both a business's Facebook and Instagram accounts

questions.text: Which content style tends to perform best for businesses on TikTok?
Why should a Social Media VA regularly check analytics?
choices: To see which content is working and adjust the strategy
Only to fill out a report no one reads
To decide the client's personal opinions

questions.text: What is one benefit of using a dedicated scheduling tool instead of posting manually every day?
choices: It removes the need to ever check the account again
It saves time and keeps posting consistent even on busy days
It replaces the need for a content calendar

questions.text: Which of these is a reporting/analytics tool mentioned for tracking performance?
What is the purpose of a content calendar?
choices: To randomly decide what to post each day
To plan posts in advance around themes, dates, and goals
To replace the need for captions

questions.text: What makes a caption 'engaging'?
choices: It is as long and generic as possible
It hooks the reader and invites a response, matching the brand's voice

questions.text: How should a Social Media VA handle a negative comment on a client's post?
choices: Respond professionally and flag it to the client if needed

questions.text: What is a good hashtag strategy?
choices: Using only one extremely popular hashtag every time
Mixing broad, niche, and branded hashtags relevant to the post
Copying a competitor's hashtags word for word without checking relevance

questions.text: Why is community management (replying to comments/messages) important?
choices: It has no effect on engagement
It builds trust and keeps followers engaged with the brand
It should be skipped to save time
It is only needed once a year

questions.text: What is a 'mock campaign' used for in a portfolio?
choices: A sample campaign created to demonstrate your skills

questions.text: How should mock projects be labeled in a portfolio?
choices: As real client results with no disclaimer
Clearly and honestly as sample or practice work
As guaranteed outcomes for future clients

questions.text: What is a good way to showcase results in a portfolio?
choices: Clear before/after examples with real or realistic metrics
Only screenshots of your own social media

questions.text: Which free tools work well for building a simple portfolio page?
Why is a portfolio valuable even without paid social media client experience?
choices: It proves your skills with content calendars, captions, and design
It replaces the need for any actual skills

questions.text: What should a Social Media VA resume bullet point focus on?
choices: Specific results, like engagement or follower growth, with numbers when possible
Personal hobbies unrelated to the role

questions.text: What makes a strong proposal for a social media job posting?
choices: A generic copy-paste message sent to everyone
Personalization that references the specific brand and its goals
No mention of relevant tools or skills

questions.text: Which platforms are commonly used to find Social Media VA clients?
choices: None, clients cannot be found online

questions.text: What is a good goal during a discovery call with a potential client?
choices: Understand the client's goals, current challenges, and expectations
Refuse to discuss the client's brand

questions.text: A good freelance profile headline for a Social Media VA should be:
choices: Specific and benefit-driven, naming the platforms and value you offer

quizzes.title: Module 6 Quiz: Landing Your First Client and Beyond

questions.text: What is a good first step when onboarding a new social media client?
choices: Guess what they want without asking
Clarify goals, brand voice, login access, and posting schedule in writing
Avoid all communication in week one

questions.text: Which is a common pricing model for Social Media VA services?
choices: Charging only in a currency you don't understand

questions.text: What is a practical way to manage multiple client accounts without mixing them up?
choices: Use one shared login for every client
Use separate scheduling calendars and clearly labeled folders per client
Post the same content to every client's page

questions.text: How should a Social Media VA respond to difficult client feedback?
choices: Take it personally and stop responding
Listen professionally, clarify the concern, and revise where reasonable
Argue that the client is always wrong

questions.text: What helps build a long-term Social Media VA career?
choices: Refusing to learn new platforms or tools
Asking for testimonials and continuously learning new platform features
